description: Card spec validation (docs/decisions/cards.md, Validation and errors) and positions (fractional indexing), as the Swift HealthCards module gives them. The server's port must give the same, errors in the same order, word for word. Mode "input" canonicalizes (CardSpec(input:)): the canonical form, or the errors. Mode "stored" is the store's check (CardSpec.storedErrors). "between" gives null where it throws. Generated by scripts/generate-health-cards from CardValidationCases: don't edit.
